note: Ground truth for scoring, held apart from the stream so a triage prototype is measured rather than admired. 'incident' groups reports that describe the same thing, so duplicate detection can be counted. 'category' is a defensible reading of the brief's three buckets, not an official Council triage - argue with it.

categories.verify: plausible but unconfirmed; check before acting

fields.ambiguous: the report named a place that exists in more than one location. Refusing to place it is the right answer.
fields.unfounded: placed where every nearby gauge was dry. Not proof it is false - a burst main floods a street on a dry day.
fields.basis: what in the ground truth or the gauge record justifies this.

caveat: Ground truth for this event comes from news reporting, not from a Council incident log. No such log is public. Times are approximate to the hour except the declaration, which was reported precisely.
